changes: Anthropic native thinking blocks now reach the real reasoning display path.
Popup precedence blocks background Ctrl+O detail toggles; stream draining is capped per wake for input fairness.
Live stream tail cap tracks character counts and trims only on overflow.
Static tool history now has a separate collapsed/expandable modal, preserving immutable insert_before scrollback.
Actual StreamChunk::Reasoning content is committed as a separate bounded muted 💭 block before stream cleanup; final Answer remains Markdown.
Inline viewport uses a stable 14-row cap; ratatui clamps it to the current terminal height and restores the cap after growth.
Tool History supports page navigation and Home/End jumps while retaining query filtering and Enter expansion.
Final events now normalize both '(final) ...' and the engine's 'reason#N: (final) ...' form, preserving the 🤖 Markdown Answer path.
Added a discoverable /history slash command and completion entry that opens the existing bounded searchable Tool History without changing /tools configured-tool semantics.
Added a deterministic TestBackend static-scrollback fidelity regression for multi-block order, ANSI/control sanitization, and wide-character width invariants; no PTY batching was introduced.
Reasoning first-line metadata now projects only observed graph step, task token estimate, and elapsed task time; unobserved step is omitted, and static/live paths share the tested formatter.
Live reasoning projection now keeps one actual reasoning row beside a visible Answer tail; reasoning remains full-viewport while Answer is absent, and static scrollback remains unchanged.
Live rendering now adds a one-cell semantic rail for Answer, reasoning, tool summary/detail, and focused tool rows; it is a pure visual projection and never fabricates tool success/failure state.

NLM's auto-collapse recommendation is already covered by the default one-row reasoning projection; Ctrl+R now exposes an explicit Live inspection view that expands actual reasoning while retaining one Answer row and focused-tool summary.

Inline viewport now uses a stable 14-row cap; a deterministic TestBackend regression proves ratatui clamps to a small terminal and restores the cap after growth, preserving the adaptive layout contract.

Live Answer now reuses the bounded line-level Markdown parser for inline code, bold, headers, and fenced-code state; full lines advance fence state before cell-width clipping, while static Markdown and scrollback remain unchanged.

Input chrome now exposes submit versus queue mode: idle uses an ANSI16 Primary Input title/border, busy uses ANSI16 Warn Queue [N] title/border, and narrow terminals use a bounded Q:[N] title; input behavior and key semantics are unchanged.
Context pressure now colors the existing status bar from the observed ctx% only: below 80 muted, 80–94 Warn, and 95–100 Error; no budget inference, stop logic, token counter, or timer was added.

Long-answer frame regression now streams 100 reasoning lines and 100 Answer lines and verifies the latest Answer tail, semantic rails, and Input/Queue slot remain visible; no eager insert_before or extra Live window state was added.
ToolBlock 获会话稳定 id；LiveTranscript 维护 focused_tool。
无模态页时 Alt+Up/Down 移动焦点，Ctrl+O 切换焦点块；无工具或浮窗不抢输入键。
焦点摘要显示 ▸ 标记；长详情裁尾时仍保留焦点摘要，详情最多 20 行。

apply_edits tool-call projection now parses edits[{path,old_string,new_string}], shows bounded file/edit counts and up to three paths in the collapsed summary, and keeps bounded per-edit ± detail rows for Ctrl+O.
The apply_edits projection is parameter-only: it adds no disk I/O, protocol fields, status inference, key change, or safety-gate change; act observations remain the success/error source of truth.
Busy-bar tool intent projection now carries the current pending_call through Ui only for rendering; Superstep syncs it, while submit, abort, done, and retry paths clear stale state.

The projection is conservative and bounded: file/search tools expose only a sensitive-marker-redacted, clipped sanitized path, apply_edits/todo_write expose counts, and shell commands, contents, old/new text, URLs, and credential-like values stay hidden.

Live reasoning-to-Answer transition now uses a one-cell visual branch rail: a reasoning segment starts with `┌`, an adjacent Answer starts with `╰`, and ordinary continuation rows retain their semantic rails; the projection uses rendered line-kind adjacency only and does not claim hidden block causality.

Active visible reasoning tail now gets a Primary rail and real reasoning metadata only when the UI is busy and that rendered reasoning row is the last visible row; idle or non-tail reasoning remains Muted. No LiveBlock step field or new state was added.

Live Answer code-fence scope rail now uses only visible-line state: fence rows use one cell, confirmed body rows use one cell, and a tail-clipped opener retains the ordinary rail; no parser state is persisted. The narrow TestBackend regression also asserts clipped opener rows contain neither code rail.

The visible Reasoning-to-focused-Tool-to-Answer connector now uses adjacent rendered line kinds only: focused ToolSummary after Reasoning gets ├ and Answer after ToolSummary/ToolDetail gets ╰; no causal block or step state is inferred.
Existing deterministic Tool failure colors now project to ToolSummary/ToolDetail rails through live_tool_rail_role; no new status field or failure string matching was added.

Latest Answer context is now anchored within the existing answer_budget: only an overlong latest Answer gets a header, one UI ellipsis, and its tail; short answers, reasoning/tool/input budgets, Markdown parser ownership, and key semantics remain unchanged.

Focused tool detail rows now inherit the focused block's one-cell Primary rail through visible adjacent-row state; no focus_index, LiveBlock field, key, outcome inference, or data-model change was added.
Live Answer opening fences now show a bounded ‹language› badge when a valid token fits; the one-cell rail, Markdown parser semantics, and static scrollback remain unchanged.
